title: AI Platform Trial Playbook for CX Ambassadors (draft)
summary: Working draft: short, low-touch playbook and micro-battlecards for Customer Experience (CX) ambassadors to run 30-day trials with integration-oriented prospects. Focus: reduce time-to-first-success, minimize engineering lift, and arm ambassadors with quick rebuttals and conversion hooks.
slide_outline: Title + one-liner: Why 30-day trials (value + low friction)
Slide 1: Target persona & trigger events (Integration Architects, Platform PMs, Security-aware startups)
Slide 2: Success criteria & conversion signals (SLA proxies, latency, cost per 1k tokens, uptime during test)
Slide 3: Trial offer mechanics (reserved sandbox capacity, onboarding window, concierge checks)
Slide 4: Quick technical checklist for SEs (API keys, network egress, example payloads)
Slide 5: Common objections & TL;DR responses (privacy, cost, model quality)
Slide 7: ROI snippets and customer evidence (sample savings, throughput gains)
Slide 8: Playbook next steps & handoff to AE/Customer Success
top_3_value_props: Predictable unit cost during trial — fixed per-token cap to avoid surprise bills
Zero-change SDK compatibility — plug into same API/tests you ship to production
Fallback resilience — automatic routing to compatible variants if regional capacity spikes
objection_handling: Privacy/data concerns: 'We support a Private trial variant (VPC) and can enable request-level logging redaction; if they need an air-gapped eval we can scope a short on-prem proof.'
'We already have a vendor' / 'Switching risk': 'Small pilot first — keep both in parallel for a month and measure token economics + latency for your top 10 flows.'
Cost unknowns: 'We set a consumption cap and daily alerts; we'll model expected spend based on your sample traffic during onboarding.'
Latency worries: 'We provide a pre-test harness to run endpoints from their region and report 95th/99th percentiles; typical wins come from KV caching and micro-batching we enable in the trial.'
pilot_flow: 1) Qualification call (15 min) — confirm persona, data sensitivity, SLO targets, and sample payloads
2) Technical kickoff (30–45 min) — share test keys, quick integration guide, and a Postman/Playwright sample
3) Day 0–7: 'First response' phase — run smoke tests, verify latency and correctness on 10 canonical prompts
4) Day 8–14: 'Ramp & measure' — increase QPS, enable prefix caching, collect token and latency metrics
5) Day 15–25: 'Optimization' — apply batching/quantization suggestions (if using Dedicated or Private), test fallback policies
6) Day 26–30: 'Decision week' — present results dashboard, recommended model variant, estimated run-rate costs
7) Handoff: AE + CSM adoption plan or plan to end trial and deliver final report
metrics_and_targets: Time to first successful generation < 48 hours
95th perc latency < target SLA (customer-specific; default target 350 ms for typical web queries)
Cost per 1k tokens under agreed cap (example target: <$6 / 1k tokens for retrieval-augmented workloads)
Conversion signal: technical POC approved + signed SOW within 60 days
Data retention: logs accessed and retained only for trial window unless customer opts in
call_scripts: Email subject: 'Quick trial to validate latency & cost for your embedding pipeline — 30 days, low lift'

Email body: 'Hi <Name>, we can spin up a short, instrumented trial that mirrors your top 3 inference paths. You get a temporary sandbox, a small reserved capacity, and a success dashboard. Can we do a 15-min kickoff on Tuesday to drop test keys and run the first smoke tests? — Priya'
Slack DM (short): 'Got 10 mins to validate a sub-350ms 95th latency test from your region? I can wire a sandbox now and share results in <24h>.'
Voicemail script: 'Hi <Name>, Priya from Redwood — quick trial offer to prove latency & unit cost for your customer-facing flows. I'll email the details.'
sample_battlecard_snippets: One-liner objection response: 'If they say latency is too variable — propose a dedicated 4-week mini-reserved pool with a rollback policy.'
Competitive angle: 'We decouple model choice from routing — can transparently show cost/latency tradeoffs for each variant you test.'
Escalation note for SEs: 'If the customer needs custom kernels or on-prem checks, loop in eng-private-deployments@redwood and schedule a gated architecture review.'
